### Set actions and bot behavior
Describe carefully in variable `actions` available operations for the bot. 

In variable `reactions` define how bot should react to the given action (e.g. inform user about triggering the specific action). 

⚠️ **Feel free to define your own actions - remember to set also correct paths in your Typebot chatflow.**

🚨 **Be careful about the structure of the content - please be consistent as this data is passed to the agents.**

### Define action
This chain is responsible for recognizing the action that user wants to trigger based on the context of the message.

### Merge all data
Merge input message, session ID, category variable, actions, reactions and recognized action together.

### Agent switcher
Forward the message (query) to the specific agent (based on choice of the user in Typebot).

### Agents (generate output message)
Those agents are responsible for retrieving data from GitHub docs and answersing questions related to Typebot/n8n. 

⚠️ **For your use case, you can change those agents entirely, add your own tools, prompts and functionalities.**

🚨 **Remember to keep user message, actions and reactions in the context window of the agent.**

### Response data
Merge defined action and output from agent. Send data back to Typebot.

## ⚠️ Note

1. Complete video guide for this workflow is available [on my YouTube](https://youtu.be/Qmru6rZ16oE).
2. Remember to add your credentials and configure nodes.
3. If you like this workflow, please subscribe to [my YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@workfloows) and/or [my newsletter](https://workfloows.com/).

**Thank you for your support!**

## Smart Multi-Agent Chat Bot

This workflow is responsible for recognizing the user’s intention to perform a specific action (e.g., signing up for the newsletter) and composing a response using one of the AI agents (previously chosen by the user).

The workflow uses [Typebot](https://typebot.io/) as a chat interface to run both regular LLM conversations and perform actions defined by this workflow.

## 🚨 Important

This workflow is intended to connect and use with [Typebot](https://typebot.io/). You can download example Typebot workflow [here](https://gist.github.com/workfloows/5e580d600213bbda4ebc8fe36d4731c8).

To use Typebot chatflow:
1. Go to [source file](https://gist.github.com/workfloows/5e580d600213bbda4ebc8fe36d4731c8) of the chat flow, save it e.g. as `chatflow.json`
2. Go to Typebot dashboard and click "Create a typebot"
3. Click "Import a file"
4. Select saved JSON file from step 1

Video guide for this concept is available on [my YouTube channel](https://youtu.be/Qmru6rZ16oE).

### Chat trigger
Use the chat webhook link to transfer the data from Typebot to n8n.
